Interiors, not just painting.

The inside of your home is personal to you. Whether it is a warm, cosy living room, a loud, bright playroom or a hand painted bespoke kitchen, Adam helps you get the ambience right for the room.

  • Wallpapering
  • Decorative wall coverings
  • Coving
  • Stenciling
  • Specialist paint effects
  • Hand painted wall murals

Clean, tidy, little disruption.

Surface preparation is the key to a great finish, but it can also create a lot of dust. All carpets, flooring and furniture are covered and protected at all times, and there is a post decoration clean up at the end of every working day.

Murals and wallcoverings.

Choose any picture, photo or design and have it tailored to your exact requirements: landscapes, architecture, nature, cartoon characters, contemporary designs, business logos and graphics.

Traditional

The picture is painted directly onto your wall. Adam is a keen, highly skilled artist, so he does this himself.

Digital

Images are digitally printed onto high strength wallpaper with fade free UV stabilised inks, then hung like traditional rolls of wallpaper.

Wallpaper feature walls

First impressions start outside.

The outside of a property protects you from rot, damp and drafts, and many Cambridgeshire homes have Victorian, Georgian and Edwardian features worth keeping beautiful. A good level of preparation is what makes it last.

  • Preparation and painting of masonry, pebbledash and brickwork
  • Restoration of sash windows
  • Painting, staining and varnishing of exterior woodwork: doors, windows, facia boards, soffits, gable ends, porch areas, decking, fences, sheds and even garden furniture

Commercial work, around your business.

Decorating a shop, office, warehouse or hotel can play a role in its success. Adam has built up a modest portfolio of commercial customers in the Cambridgeshire area, from large corporate companies to localised shops and offices: office blocks, research laboratories, warehouse refurbishments, shop fronts and even university boathouses.

Flexible working hours: early morning, late evenings or through the night, to cause minimal disruption to the everyday running of your business.

Decorator, artist, business graduate.

  • At school, his art teacher secretly entered his work into the Heffer’s art gallery competition in Cambridgeshire, and it won 1st prize. He went on to an A* in GCSE Art & Design.
  • From 1996, Cambridge Regional College: a GNVQ in Advanced Business by day, a City & Guilds qualification in Painting and Decorating in the evenings.
  • A BA Honours in Business & Marketing at London Metropolitan University, then his own decorating business after graduating in 2001.
  • He began by sub-contracting for larger decorating firms and building contractors, and still knows tradesmen who can help if you need a door replaced, a radiator moved or a light switch changed.
